chapters.title: The Opportunity

chapters.argument: The working constraint is proposition clarity, not reach: FIELDWORK has no validated reason for qualified buyers to choose it over familiar alternatives.
chapters.decision: If a clearer proposition fails to improve qualified landing-page progression and purchase intent versus the current message, reject this diagnosis.
chapters.title: The Constraint

chapters.argument: The proposed advantage is practical design for the overlap between work and home, expressed with more honesty and character than generic productivity products.
chapters.decision: Compare relevance, distinctiveness, willingness to pay and unprompted recall against two alternative territories.
chapters.title: The Advantage

chapters.argument: Make FIELDWORK the most useful and recognisable expression of modern work at home, then prove the proposition in conversion and repeat before scaling acquisition.
chapters.decision: Approve only the next tests, not the modelled revenue outcome.
